prompts.granary-v2:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: an individual transparent PNG sprite for a playable 2:1 isometric Jiangnan village management game.
Input image 1 is ONLY the A art-direction reference, not an edit target. Input image 2 is ONLY a matching dwelling material/lighting reference, not an edit target.
Style: match the village in reference A: finely hand-painted natural materials, lived-in cream plaster, charcoal clay tiles or ochre straw as appropriate, warm subdued sunlight from upper left, restrained olive foliage. Same 2:1 ground plane and three-quarter elevated orthographic camera. Readable at 140–180 screen pixels wide. Human-sized door approx one third building wall height.
Composition: isolated entire object centered, all extremities visible, small transparent margin. True transparent background. No surrounding village, no grass rectangle or floating slab, no vignette, glow or halo, no labels, no UI, no people, no smoke or active production. Only a very small soft contact shadow. Every pixel outside object and its tiny contact shadow must be alpha zero.
Primary request: one modest rural Chinese communal grain store, a compact single-storey square timber barn with a low golden straw hipped roof and weathered ochre wood walls. A small central closed double door faces southwest, a few rice sacks, 2 wicker grain baskets and 2 grey earthen jars gathered beside the door. Low stone footing, a little irregular worn earth below the sacks, two small grass/white-flower tufts. It should have the intimate scale and thatch construction of the selected granary shown in reference A, NOT a large town hall, pagoda, western barn or mansion. Clear silhouette; roof height restrained.

prompts.path-earth-v2:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless terrain material for a hand-painted isometric Chinese village game.
Primary request: one SQUARE perfectly tileable top-down dry footpath / courtyard earth texture. Warm pale ochre, weathered compacted sandy soil, very fine subtle grain, sparse tiny irregular grey pebbles and faint worn patches. Painterly natural material at the same restrained detailed scale as Jiangnan village reference A. Even ambient daylight with NO cast shadows or directional lighting. No large stones, paving blocks, vegetation, leaves, cracks, tracks, objects, grid, border, typography or large contrast blobs. Fully opaque flat material across the complete square canvas, edges tile seamlessly, no perspective, no vignette, no margins. Must read as pale lived-in rural earthen paths rather than beach sand or dark farmland.
